svg.aria-label: L1 across game files: two cubes
svg.title: L1 across game files: two cubes
svg.text: L1 across game files: two cubes
One cube per weather. Its three axes: the horse, a marriage, a baby — 8 game files per cube, 16 in all.
H = horse · M = married · B = a baby (lit = yes). Green = tables ready · orange dashes = measured in the lab, pages to come · grey = later.
Sunny: the two filled corners share one L1, 3 game frames apart. Rainy: one L1 at the same moment. Married: the single file's L1, same moment.
Each corner = one game file's tables; a filled corner shows its L1 (the most common dog line), 0–40 s after READY.
